stem: How did these events affect the United States?

options.label: F
options.text: They increased public support for cuts in U.S. defense spending.

options.label: G
options.text: They prompted the end of Dollar Diplomacy in Latin America.

options.label: H
options.text: They set a precedent of including territorial acquisitions in settlements.

options.label: J
options.text: They helped establish the United States as an imperial power similar to European nations.

visual_elements: The USS Maine sinks in Havana Harbor.
The Treaty of Paris is signed.
